about_the_game:
Survive the Ancestral Spirit Realm

Axe Me Why is a post-apocalyptic horde fighter where every run is a battle for survival and legacy. You play as Tsuki, a lone warrior raised by her village but haunted by the mystery of her missing parents. Their civilization swallowed by the Spirit Realm, she fights to preserve her own strength while ensuring the long-term survival of the people who raised her. Each 15-minute run challenges you to fight, forage, and adapt while defending your village’s fading spirit while the stories of your fellow villagers unfold with your actions. From religion, to new societal structures, friendly neighbours and serial killers, look to find your place in this new form of life.

Gameplay Overview

Your goal is simple: endure until you return home.
But survival depends on hard choices. During each run you’ll gather and ration four vital resources: Fuel, Canned Foods, Electronics, and Spirit Essence. These can be:
• Saved to strengthen your village between runs, unlocking permanent upgrades and ancestral blessings, or
• Spent mid-battle to summon Ancestral Powers, unleashing devastating attacks or temporary buffs that can turn the tide.

Every run reshapes the world, introducing new enemy types, random events, and evolving challenges that test how well you can adapt under pressure. Special event islands appear at the 3, 6, 9, and 12-minute marks, offering story moments or boss fights that pause the timer and expand your total expedition time. Returning home at the 15-minute mark completes the cycle, but players who explore every event can expect sessions of roughly 15 to 25 minutes.

Progression and Story Structure

Story progress is unlocked through the total amount of resources collected across all runs. Completing chapters requires gathering milestones of Fuel, Canned Foods, Electronics, and Spirit Essence, as well as defeating elite enemies and earning Appraisal through performance.

Throughout the story, Tsuki’s search for her maternal parents unfolds across eight narrative chapters. Guided by an angel named Modiloi and an ancient expeditioner much like herself, she begins to uncover truths buried deep within the world’s history. What starts as a personal search soon becomes a revelation that could reshape the fate of her people and the realm itself.

Each chapter introduces new enemies, bosses, and quests, expanding the procedural world and culminating in the final test Baloi le Mangeloyi, where Tsuki must face the echoes of her discovery.

Efficient players can complete the story in about 8 hours of gameplay, while retries, exploration, and unlockables can extend total playtime to 20–25 hours.

Core Features
• Fast-Paced Horde Combat: Battle swarms of spirits, beasts, and corrupted souls in high-intensity arenas inspired by Survivor-style gameplay.
• Dynamic Resource System: Balance survival and sacrifice. Use supplies for short-term power or invest them for long-term village growth.
• Village Progression: After each run, return home to rebuild your ancestral camp, unlocking new upgrades, characters, abilities, and blessings.
• Story Chapters and Quests: Progress through 8 interconnected story arcs that unfold as you gather resources and conquer elite enemies.
• Character-Driven Narrative: Follow Tsuki’s journey as she pieces together the truth about her lineage and the origins of the Ancestral Spirit Realm.
• Evolving Skill Paths: Discover relics and ancestral sigils that alter your powers each run, creating unique builds and playstyles.
• Stylized African-Inspired Visuals: Experience a world infused with mystical African motifs, hand-crafted textures, and spiritual energy effects.
• Immersive Soundtrack: Dynamic music that rises with intensity as hordes grow and your powers awaken.
• Replayability: Procedurally influenced encounters and scaling challenges ensure no two runs feel the same.

Game Structure and Playtime
Each session lasts roughly 15 to 25 minutes, depending on how many event islands you explore. Progress carries across runs through village upgrades, resource totals, and unlocked chapters, making every defeat a step toward mastery. Whether you focus on endurance, story progression, or unlocking every ancestral memory, Axe Me Why offers dozens of replayable hours of fast, strategic, and visually striking gameplay.

Answer the Call
Face endless hordes. Harness ancestral might.
Endure, adapt, and fight your way back home for yourself, and for those who came before you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Designed for rasterization (no ray tracing). For older GPUs use Low/Medium settings; Lumen/RT off. GTX 1060 3 GB is not recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 120 Hz+ monitors. Widescreens are supported. Supports V-Sync and high-refresh displays up to 144 Hz / 240 Hz. SSD recommended.

short_description: Survive 15-minute runs with 3D movement & uneven terrain in the Spirit Realm. Fight, forage & adapt while defending your village’s fading spirit. The stories of your people unfolding with your actions, new religions, good neighbors, spirit-tech punks & serial killers all rely on you to see tomorrow.
